status: Source-bounded research triage. New leads found; publication/submission condition not met. No clinical efficacy estimates. Selected primary-source appraisals are separate from all-entity screening.
matching: Only exact normalized compound aliases; report collision or multi-match instead of choosing silently. Unmatched entries are unknown, not failed candidates.

decisions.evidence_scope: Previously reviewed route rationale; grouping does not establish identical drug-specific effects.
decisions.rationale: The open-label strength changes do not establish disease-specific rescue; [study details and control strategy](track2-evidence-pipeline.md#why-this-pair-and-what-remains-to-be-proved). The SIRT2 survival result was genetic; NMN abundance experiments were a different intervention. No niacin/N1002K rescue exists. A [pediatric MTTN case](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/39173541/) progressed despite NAD correction. The [prescription label](https://dailymed.nlm.nih.gov/dailymed/fda/fdaDrugXsl.cfm?setid=dd60fe81-3d54-4a29-9502-601be89c575e) does not establish pediatric safety/effectiveness.

decisions.evidence_scope: Previously reviewed route rationale; grouping does not establish identical drug-specific effects.
decisions.rationale: Two mice/genotype, no total-substrate denominators, quantification or inferential test: increased pathway activity is unestablished. Carrier findings do not establish biallelic MVA1 signaling or drug rescue. X753 differs from L737Ter; mouse L1002P models human L1012P, not N1002K. [Baker's rapamycin nonbenefit](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC3785294/) is a parenthetical unpublished observation, without a treatment figure or complete regimen. [Goutas 2023](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC10149375/), Fig. 6, found BUBR1 loss after 50 nM everolimus for 24 hours in late-passage WJ-MSCs, not early-passage cells.

decisions.evidence_scope: Previously reviewed route rationale; grouping does not establish identical drug-specific effects.
decisions.rationale: The published fly study reports rapamycin feeding improving neuroblast counts. Genetic autophagy/TOR interventions did not restore progeny counts or brain size; drug and genetic endpoint sets must remain separate. This is a different checkpoint lesion and neural tissue, not BUB1B muscle. The BubR1 mouse negative observation was an unpublished parenthetical, not a fully reported treatment trial. No comparative MVA superiority established.

decisions.disposition: mechanistic reference, decline approved-drug submission lead
decisions.evidence_scope: Previously reviewed route rationale; grouping does not establish identical drug-specific effects.
decisions.rationale: WT abundance and high experimental exposures do not establish actual-mutant or muscle rescue. Genetic SIRT2 improved selected outcomes but did not reverse small size, cataracts or lordokyphosis. NMN drug eligibility is unestablished.

decisions.evidence_scope: Previously reviewed route rationale; grouping does not establish identical drug-specific effects.
decisions.rationale: No BUBR1 rescue. A [12-week randomized study](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/31710095/) in 40 obese, insulin-resistant men found no increase in muscle NAD or improvement in mitochondrial respiration with 1,000 mg twice daily. Product-level approved-drug eligibility is unestablished.

decisions.evidence_scope: Previously reviewed route rationale; grouping does not establish identical drug-specific effects.
decisions.rationale: It is not nicotinic acid. North's high-dose nicotinamide reduced BUBR1, consistent with sirtuin inhibition; that does not establish that every concentration is harmful. No useful BUBR1 rescue window established.

decisions.evidence_scope: Previously reviewed route rationale; grouping does not establish identical drug-specific effects.
decisions.rationale: Direct NAD experiments used 10 mM mouse myotubes; the human diabetes study had rebound fatty acids and worse insulin sensitivity. A [two-week trial](https://doi.org/10.1515/teb-2024-0030) found no functional/protein-synthesis benefit. In [11 older people with probable sarcopenia](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/40100528/), four weeks produced no significant muscle-NAD increase or secondary benefit.

decisions.evidence_scope: Previously reviewed route rationale; grouping does not establish identical drug-specific effects.
decisions.rationale: No BUBR1 functional rescue. HSP90 dependence of selected mutants does not prove rescue by another stress-response mechanism. The label's mean pediatric serum peak is about 1.7 µM, versus 200–400 µM in some NPC cell experiments; these are total serum and nominal culture quantities, not matched free tissue exposure. [IBM](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/37739573/) and [ALS](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/38782015/) randomized trials were negative, with tolerability limitations; neither tested MVA.

decisions.evidence_scope: Previously reviewed route rationale; grouping does not establish identical drug-specific effects.
decisions.rationale: No BUBR1-specific rescue. ABCA1 work used 10 mM for 24 hours. Broad effects on folding and gene regulation complicate mechanism. [Different STXBP1 zebrafish alleles](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC13251787/) failed to show useful phenotypic rescue; their truncating/deletion lesions do not directly refute rescuing a surviving missense protein.

decisions.evidence_scope: Previously reviewed route rationale; grouping does not establish identical drug-specific effects.
decisions.rationale: It is not equivalent to adding free phenylbutyrate to culture: absorption, hydrolysis, protein binding and metabolism determine exposure. Neither pediatric approval nor the STXBP1 trial [NCT04937062](https://clinicaltrials.gov/study/NCT04937062), with no posted results at review, establishes BUBR1 efficacy.

decisions.evidence_scope: Previously reviewed route rationale; grouping does not establish identical drug-specific effects.
decisions.rationale: HSP90, BUBR1 rescue and muscle renewal were not measured. The Japanese label reports no pediatric clinical trials. Heat-shock-protein induction is not functional rescue.

decisions.disposition: conditional mechanism experiment, decline muscle-rescue lead
decisions.evidence_scope: Previously reviewed route rationale; grouping does not establish identical drug-specific effects.
decisions.rationale: MG132 preservation was not demonstrated drug-mediated checkpoint rescue; N1002K was untested. Proteasome blockade can itself prevent mitotic exit, confounding an arrest-only rescue assay. The [pediatric bortezomib/vorinostat trial](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/22887890/) does not establish BUB1B selectivity; no starting renal adjustment in the [label](https://dailymed.nlm.nih.gov/dailymed/fda/fdaDrugXsl.cfm?setid=0eb8daef-18da-43bb-b7c6-38c4c8b5dd80&type=display) is not proof of safety in nephrocalcinosis.

decisions.evidence_scope: Previously reviewed route rationale; grouping does not establish identical drug-specific effects.
decisions.rationale: Geldanamycin destabilized tested MVA mutants; Tang's BUBR1-low AICAR/17-AAG result measured cell accumulation/survival, not muscle rescue. Killing vulnerable cells could worsen tissue supply.

decisions.evidence_scope: Previously reviewed route rationale; grouping does not establish identical drug-specific effects.
decisions.rationale: It is not a selective NMD probe. A [G542X CF organoid study](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC7794695/) did not show the expected useful enhancement, illustrating context dependence. Historical approval is not current systemic availability, NMD approval or BUB1B rescue; [US Aphthasol dental paste is listed discontinued](https://api.fda.gov/drug/drugsfda.json?search=application_number:NDA020511).

decisions.evidence_scope: Previously reviewed route rationale; grouping does not establish identical drug-specific effects.
decisions.rationale: No BUB1B or Leu737Ter experiment. The actual UGA-A context, NMD-limited RNA and inserted amino acid can change success. Overlap between nominal culture concentration and a pediatric plasma peak does not match duration, free intracellular exposure or muscle-ribosome availability. A full-length band is not normal protein function.

decisions.evidence_scope: Previously reviewed route rationale; grouping does not establish identical drug-specific effects.
decisions.rationale: No BUB1B response. Surviving transcript, stop context, inserted amino acid and full-length protein function all matter. NMD may reduce substrate without making it zero. Gentamicin's kidney/hearing liabilities constrain use. [Ataluren EU authorization was not renewed in 2025](https://www.ema.europa.eu/en/medicines/human/EPAR/translarna) after efficacy remained unconfirmed; this does not falsify the entire mechanism.

decisions.evidence_scope: Previously reviewed route rationale; grouping does not establish identical drug-specific effects.
decisions.rationale: These cells are not muscle progenitors or muscle-supporting cells. Monotherapy cannot inherit genetic-clearance or combination results. Broad kinase effects, blood-cell toxicity and interactions require a useful window.

decisions.disposition: selective-clearance research reserve, decline current medication lead
decisions.evidence_scope: Previously reviewed route rationale; grouping does not establish identical drug-specific effects.
decisions.rationale: Baker used INK-ATTAC/AP20187, not navitoclax. [Human phase I experience](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC4979082/) found platelet toxicity with intermittent as well as continuous exposure; sparing megakaryocytes does not establish survival of BCL-XL-dependent platelets. No pediatric MVA senolytic pulse schedule or approved-product eligibility was established here.

decisions.evidence_scope: Previously reviewed route rationale; grouping does not establish identical drug-specific effects.
decisions.rationale: Suppressing harmful secretions is different from killing cells. Neither study demonstrates ruxolitinib rescue of developmental BUB1B disease or proves that JAK-dependent secretions cause its muscle defect. Xu's broader secretion/conditioned-medium experiments used JAK inhibitor 1; they cannot all be assigned to ruxolitinib. The [drug label](https://dailymed.nlm.nih.gov/dailymed/fda/fdaDrugXsl.cfm?setid=f1c82580-87ae-11e0-bc84-0002a5d5c51b) adds cytopenia, infection and developmental-exposure constraints.

decisions.evidence_scope: Previously reviewed route rationale; grouping does not establish identical drug-specific effects.
decisions.rationale: Tang's BUBR1-low experiment tested AICAR/17-AAG, not chloroquine; chloroquine did not suppress the tested human CIN/MIN lines. Goutas measured abundance, not restored function, at high culture exposure. [Chloroquine](https://www.dailymed.nlm.nih.gov/dailymed/drugInfo.cfm?setid=f4ac1556-0522-76e3-e053-2a95a90a5ba8) and [hydroxychloroquine](https://www.dailymed.nlm.nih.gov/dailymed/drugInfo.cfm?setid=f2002851-852f-4ee8-e053-2a95a90a242d) labels warn about muscle weakness/myopathy, particularly relevant to this objective.

decisions.evidence_scope: Previously reviewed route rationale; grouping does not establish identical drug-specific effects.
decisions.rationale: Antiproliferation is not muscle rescue. [MASTERS randomized trial](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC6826125/) found metformin blunted resistance-training muscle hypertrophy in older adults. That result does not settle pediatric MVA, but opposes an assumed anabolic benefit. AICAR reference experiments cannot be assigned to metformin.

decisions.evidence_scope: Previously reviewed route rationale; grouping does not establish identical drug-specific effects.
decisions.rationale: No demonstrated BUB1B-dependent redox cause or rescue. The [randomized RYR1-myopathy trial](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC7274912/) failed its primary oxidative-stress endpoint and did not establish a functional benefit. It is a different myopathy but stronger than a generic antioxidant rationale. In Sod1-null oocytes, NAC and ascorbate reduced premature sister-chromatid separation and improved normal-chromosome outcomes; distinct lesion and meiotic tissue, without demonstrated BUBR1 mediation or muscle rescue.

decisions.evidence_scope: Previously reviewed route rationale; grouping does not establish identical drug-specific effects.
decisions.rationale: [Randomized Barth primary endpoints](https://www.nature.com/articles/s41436-020-01006-8) were not met. No causally established BUB1B mitochondrial lesion or rescue. Approval population and surrogate basis do not transfer to MVA.

decisions.disposition: conditional tumor research, decline current medication lead
decisions.evidence_scope: Previously reviewed route rationale; grouping does not establish identical drug-specific effects.
decisions.rationale: The cited [NCT04158336](https://clinicaltrials.gov/study/NCT04158336) is a completed adult phase I study, not an active pediatric phase I/II/III trial (registry checked 21 September 2026). [The sponsor](https://zentalis.com/patients/clinical-trials/) identifies azenosertib as investigational and unapproved. Variant presence or CYP3A5 non-expression alone does not supply a validated response or dosing rule.

decisions.disposition: decline Track 2 lead; endocrine assessment only
decisions.evidence_scope: Previously reviewed route rationale; grouping does not establish identical drug-specific effects.
decisions.rationale: No deficiency is documented. [Clinical consensus](https://academic.oup.com/ejendo/article/186/6/P35/6853681) generally discourages GH in cancer-predisposition syndromes, with individual exceptions. Failure to thrive is not proof of hormone deficiency or a BUBR1-rescue mechanism.

decisions.disposition: decline nomination for this recorded context
decisions.evidence_scope: Previously reviewed route rationale; grouping does not establish identical drug-specific effects.
decisions.rationale: No qualifying endocrine diagnosis is established. The current label contraindicates pediatric malignant neoplasia **or a history of malignancy**; recorded rhabdomyosarcoma is directly relevant. This is stronger than a speculative growth-signal concern.

decisions.disposition: New same-gene pharmacological precedent; defer promotion
decisions.evidence_scope: Selected primary-source appraisal; model and access limits in linked review. Not actual-genotype efficacy.
decisions.rationale: Conference abstract reports longer median survival in BubR1 hypomorphic mice but no improvement in other monitored age-related phenotypes. Investigational drug; no demonstrated muscle rescue.

decisions.disposition: Endogenous-transcription reserve; relevant promoter-repression premise unestablished
decisions.evidence_scope: Selected primary-source appraisal; model and access limits in linked review. Not actual-genotype efficacy.
decisions.rationale: Increased BUBR1 expression in non-MVA cell contexts is not rescue of mutant protein; an AML cell context showed little protein restoration. Cytotoxic demethylation cannot be treated as selective usable-protein rescue.

decisions.disposition: HGPS drug analogy; no demonstrated MVA rescue
decisions.evidence_scope: Selected primary-source appraisal; model and access limits in linked review. Not actual-genotype efficacy.
decisions.rationale: HGPS progerin-directed findings with FTI-277 or UPCP do not establish lonafarnib rescue of BUB1B mutations. Drug and genotype bridges remain missing.

decisions.evidence_scope: Selected primary-source appraisal; model and access limits in linked review. Not actual-genotype efficacy.
decisions.rationale: Direct binding or inhibition of BUBR1 is not restoration of an insufficient gene product. No demonstrated useful muscle rescue.

decisions.rationale: Randomized motor-function benefit in treated SMA; no BUB1B/MVA evidence. Labeled fractures and model transfer constrain nomination. Niacin retains a distinct restoration hypothesis.

decisions.rationale: HGPS progerin-context rescue does not establish rescue of a BUB1B-mutant allele. Report correction changes the claimed tissue identity.

decisions.evidence_scope: Selected primary-source appraisal; access/model limits in linked review. Not an all-literature efficacy assessment.
decisions.rationale: BUBR1 increase in progerin context; no relevant causal interaction demonstrated in MVA and separate mitotic alignment counterevidence.

decisions.evidence_scope: Selected primary-source appraisal; access/model limits in linked review. Not an all-literature efficacy assessment.
decisions.rationale: Indirect mitotic BUBR1 stability effects do not establish appropriate checkpoint exit or durable productive tissue rescue.

decisions.evidence_scope: Selected primary-source appraisal; access/model limits in linked review. Not an all-literature efficacy assessment.

decisions.evidence_scope: Selected primary-source appraisal; access/model limits in linked review. Not an all-literature efficacy assessment.

decisions.rationale: FOP ectopic-bone prevention is a different causal receptor setting; no myostatin or BUBR1 rescue. Infection and bleeding risks remain relevant.

decisions.disposition: PI3K/mTOR reserve; no advantage over conditional pathway probe established
decisions.evidence_scope: Selected primary-source appraisal; access/model limits in linked review. Not an all-literature efficacy assessment.
decisions.rationale: Breast-cancer combination efficacy does not demonstrate harmful excess growth signaling or muscle benefit in MVA.

decisions.evidence_scope: Selected primary-source appraisal; access/model limits in linked review. Not an all-literature efficacy assessment.
decisions.rationale: Aged WT mouse coordination and multi-marker changes, with BUB1b among many markers; no BUBR1 mediation or MVA rescue. Eligible product and exposure unverified.

decisions.evidence_scope: Selected primary-source appraisal; access/model limits in linked review. Not an all-literature efficacy assessment.
decisions.rationale: Neonatal anesthesia-injury model; BUB1B one restored hub gene, no causal MVA rescue established. Do not transfer vitamin-family result to a particular menaquinone medicine.

decisions.evidence_scope: Selected primary-source appraisal; access/model limits in linked review. Not an all-literature efficacy assessment.
decisions.rationale: BUBR1 reduction in the studied differentiation context. CAPE is not caffeic acid; no derivative-to-parent efficacy transfer.

decisions.disposition: experimental chromosome-fidelity comparator; not an approved-drug lead
decisions.evidence_scope: Catalog-independent primary intervention appraisal; distinct model and outcome scopes retained.
decisions.rationale: PMID 42286606: 7,8-DHF reduced in-vitro aneuploidy in aged WT mouse oocytes. Secretome/BDNF kinetochore endpoints must not be assigned automatically to the small molecule. No BUB1B-mutant muscle rescue, exposure bridge or independently established target specificity.

decisions.disposition: mixture-level genomic-protection reserve; no defined medicine nominated
decisions.evidence_scope: Catalog-independent primary intervention appraisal; distinct model and outcome scopes retained.
decisions.rationale: Normal NCM460 colon cells had fewer abnormal mitoses/genomic-damage endpoints. BubR1 mRNA rose, but mediation was unproved. Undefined mixture; constituents cannot inherit the preparation result. No actual-allele muscle rescue.

decisions.disposition: contextual cytoprotection reserve; decline muscle-restoration lead
decisions.evidence_scope: Catalog-independent primary intervention appraisal; distinct model and outcome scopes retained.
decisions.rationale: Cryopreserved oocyte maturation improved at 10^-7 M with stage-specific Bubr1 mRNA changes. Other tested concentrations impaired maturation relative to vitrification alone. No chromosome-number, actual-allele or muscle rescue demonstrated.

decisions.evidence_scope: Catalog-independent primary intervention appraisal; distinct model and outcome scopes retained.
decisions.rationale: Hearing preservation in SAMP8 mice and cochlear protection were demonstrated. BubR1 decrease characterized oxidant injury; drug-mediated BubR1 restoration was not established. No mutant, muscle or clinical-exposure bridge.

decisions.disposition: low-priority contextual evidence; decline BUB1B-restoration lead
decisions.evidence_scope: Catalog-independent primary intervention appraisal; distinct model and outcome scopes retained.
decisions.rationale: Folate reduced toxin-induced apoptosis in bovine mammary epithelial cells. BUB1B is a network/marker association; individual cow gene differences were nonsignificant. No division-fidelity, mutant or muscle benefit demonstrated.

decisions.disposition: contextual mechanism observation; not an implementation of FRZB rescue
decisions.evidence_scope: Catalog-independent primary intervention appraisal; distinct model and outcome scopes retained.
decisions.rationale: LiCl improved spindle morphology and pronuclear formation after Axin1 depletion in oocytes. This is neither BUB1B deficiency nor the BubR1-H/H FRZB genetic rescue. No clinical lithium formulation or exposure equivalence inferred. Separate GSK3-inhibition experiments reduced checkpoint recruitment and relieved spindle-poison arrest (PMID30250048), so improved morphology cannot establish preserved SAC.

decisions.disposition: record toxin-model pharmacology; decline restoration lead
decisions.evidence_scope: Catalog-independent primary intervention appraisal; distinct model and outcome scopes retained.
decisions.rationale: Primary abstract reports reversal of chromium-associated BubR1 reduction and cell-cycle arrest. Full-text treatment details not reviewed; release from a damage response is not chromosome repair or competent-progenitor rescue. Same-gene p53 genetic counterevidence remains relevant.

decisions.evidence_scope: Source-bounded appraisal from the complete-saved-abstract follow-up and specified primary checks; verification limits retained.
decisions.rationale: Primary abstract reports BUB1B thermal stabilization. ChEMBL CETSA values are not independently checked against the original figure; heat resistance is not increased unheated abundance, slower turnover or restored checkpoint function. No qualified clinical-exposure or eligible-product bridge; do not conflate with TG101348/fedratinib.

decisions.disposition: prioritize experimental chromosome-fidelity comparator for source and exposure qualification
decisions.evidence_scope: Source-bounded appraisal from the complete-saved-abstract follow-up and specified primary checks; verification limits retained.
decisions.rationale: Actual compound treatment reduced mitotic aberrations/CIN and increased checkpoint transcripts including BubR1 in noncancerous CCD841 colon cells, with opposite checkpoint effects in HCT116 cancer cells. Noncancerous proliferation was slightly inhibited. Full source figures/exposure, BUBR1 mediation, muscle transfer and eligible product remain unresolved; stronger than a docking hit, not demonstrated MVA rescue.

decisions.evidence_scope: Source-bounded appraisal from the complete-saved-abstract follow-up and specified primary checks; verification limits retained.
decisions.rationale: Administered extract reduced ovariectomy-associated rat bone loss and osteoclast formation. Thermal profiling plus virtual screening nominates BUB1B among many targets; isolated ingredient identity, target direction/mediation and muscle/clinical-exposure bridge are not established by the accessible primary abstract. Mixture evidence is not inherited by docked constituents.

decisions.disposition: retain same-disease genetic target opportunity; no drug implementation elected
decisions.evidence_scope: Source-bounded appraisal from the complete-saved-abstract follow-up and specified primary checks; verification limits retained.
decisions.rationale: Knockdown suppressed centrosome amplification in PCS/MVA patient cells. This is not administered PLK1-inhibitor rescue. PLK1 also supports BUBR1/PP2A kinetochore attachment during mitosis, so continuous generalized inhibition may conflict with the desired interphase effect; timing and full division outcomes need qualification.

decisions.disposition: retain contextual pharmacology; decline muscle-restoration lead
decisions.evidence_scope: Source-bounded appraisal from the complete-saved-abstract follow-up and specified primary checks; verification limits retained.
decisions.rationale: RAF inhibition prevented pan-JAK-inhibitor-induced endoreduplication in HL-60 leukemia cells, with reduced BubR1 phosphorylation. This is an actual pharmacological correction of an imposed polyploidy phenotype, not BUB1B deficiency or nonmalignant muscle rescue. Dose/model transfer and eligible-product exposure remain unresolved.

decisions.route: Suan-Zao-Ren-Tang B7E2 and separately tested constituents
decisions.disposition: retain checkpoint-amplification mechanism; decline restoration nomination
decisions.evidence_scope: Source-bounded appraisal from the complete-saved-abstract follow-up and specified primary checks; verification limits retained.
decisions.rationale: B7E2 plus vinorelbine amplified BUBR1 phosphorylation/MCC and cancer killing. Primary results include a less-affected MRC-5 comparator, not restoration of normal chromosome fidelity. B7E2 alone showed no acute cytotoxicity in one setting. Mixture and constituent results remain distinct; neither combination cytotoxicity nor short-term tolerance establishes usable BUBR1 rescue.
